_help: Partner shops in AR Hunt. Copy the example, fill it in and set active to true. lat/lon: right-click the shop in Google Maps to copy them. radius is in metres (60-150 works for a shop). brandColor is a hex colour. glb is optional: put the shop's own 3D model in the partners/ folder and give its path, otherwise a branded sign is shown. validUntil (YYYY-MM-DD) ends the campaign automatically.
